en.title: Minister Shahid sends National Day greetings to Brunei Darussalam
en.description: Minister Shahid sends National Day greetings to Brunei Darussalam
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends National Day greetings to Brunei Darussalam

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid sent a message of felicitations to the Minister for Foreign Affairs II of Brunei Darussalam, His Excellency Dato Erywan Yusof on the occasion of the 39th National Day of Brunei Darussalam.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“ It is my pleasure to extend warm felicitations and good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of Brunei on the auspicious occasion of the 39th National Day of Brunei Darussalam.

I am confident that the existing strong relations between the Maldives and Brunei will strengthen in the years to come. I look forward to working closely with Your Excellency in enhancing friendship for the mutual benefit of the people of our two countries.

May I also convey my best wishes for Your Excellency’s good health, success, and continued peace, progress, and prosperity for the people of Brunei Darussalam.”

en.title: Minister Shahid reiterates Government’s commitment to promoting and protecting the rights of all migrants in the Maldives
en.description: Minister Shahid reiterates Government’s commitment to promoting and protecting the rights of all migrants in the Maldives
en.body:
Minister Shahid reiterates Government’s commitment to promoting and protecting the rights of all migrants in the Maldives

Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid participated in the Regional Meeting on the Protection of Migrants in Vulnerable Situations, held today. The event was organized by the Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) and the International Organization for Migration (IOM) to bring together stakeholders across the Asia-Pacific region to assess progress in implementing Objective 7 of the Global Compact for Safe, Orderly and Regular Migration (GCM).

In his remarks, Minister Shahid recognized the complexity of the issue of migration and highlighted some of the initiatives undertaken by President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih’s administration to cater to the needs of the migrant population in the Maldives. In this regard, he emphasized the importance accorded to inclusivity, in the Maldives’ approach to recovery from the COVID-19 pandemic. He also noted the social media programs that were launched with the help of the civil society and United Nations entities to advocate for acceptance, inclusion and empathy towards all members of the society.

Speaking further, Minister Shahid recalled the legislative actions taken by the Government, such as the establishment of the Regulation on Expatriate Employment in 2021, the Regulation of Employees Accommodation Standards in 2021 and the Employment Agency Regulation in 2022.

He concluded his remarks by reiterating the Government’s commitment to further strengthen the Maldivian legal framework to provide better protection of the rights of all migrant workers within the jurisdiction.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Founding Day greetings to Saudi Arabia
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Founding Day greetings to Saudi Arabia
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Founding Day greetings to Saudi Arabia

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, His Royal Highness Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud, on the occasion of the Founding Day of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“Your Royal Highness,

It is my pleasure to extend warm greetings and sincere felicitations to Your Royal Highness, the Government, and the brotherly people of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on the Founding Day celebrations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

I would like to commend the visionary leaders of the Kingdom, on the celebrations of the founding day coinciding the historic commemorations of the founding of the first Saudi State by the pioneering leadership of Imam Muhammad bin Saud, and for the remarkable progress the country has achieved.

I also take this opportunity to convey my personal good wishes for your good health and well-being, and for the continued happiness, prosperity and advancement of the brotherly people of Saudi Arabia.

Please accept, Your Royal Highness, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day Greetings to the Foreign Minister of Saint Lucia
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day Greetings to the Foreign Minister of Saint Lucia
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day Greetings to the Foreign Minister of Saint Lucia

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Minister of External Affairs, International Trade, Civil Aviation and Diaspora Affairs of Saint Lucia, Hon. Alva Romanus Baptiste, on the occasion of their 44th Independence Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

"On behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives and on my own behalf, I wish to extend warm felicitations and congratulations to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Saint Lucia, on the occasion of the 44th anniversary of your Independence.

As Small Island Developing States, the Maldives and Saint Lucia share similar vulnerabilities and challenges. I am confident that we can enhance our collaboration in the multilateral fora and continue to strengthen our bilateral relations to overcome common concerns in the coming years.

Please accept, Excellency, my best wishes for your good health and happiness, and for continued peace, progress and prosperity of people of Saint Lucia."

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid attends Japan Reception as Guest of Honour, to celebrate the Birthday of His Majesty the Emperor of Japan
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid attends Japan Reception as Guest of Honour, to celebrate the Birthday of His Majesty the Emperor of Japan
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid attends Japan Reception as Guest of Honour, to celebrate the Birthday of His Majesty the Emperor of Japan

Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid today attended as the Guest of Honour, the National Day Reception hosted by the Ambassador of Japan to Celebrate the Birthday of His Majesty the Emperor of Japan.

Speaking at the reception, on behalf of President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, Minister Shahid extended warm wishes to His Majesty Emperor Naruhito and conveyed greetings to Prime Minister Kishida Fumio and Foreign Minister Hayashi Yoshimasa on the auspicious occasion. Foreign Minister Shahid thanked all friends, whose cooperation and contributions have made the partnership between the two countries the strongest it has ever been over the last few decades.

During his remarks, while highlighting the close bilateral relationship steeped in history of cooperation, friendship and mutual respect between Maldives and Japan, Minister Shahid expressed gratitude to Foreign Minister Hayashi Yoshimasa for his unrelenting commitment to strengthen the relations between our two countries, and thanked Ambassador Takeuchi Midori, for her tireless efforts to promote Maldives-Japan relationship to new heights.

Minister Shahid was joined by State Minister Ahmed Khaleel, Ambassador at Large Ahmed Saleem and Senior Officials from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, at the reception.

en.title: Communique of the First Strategic Dialogue between the Maldives and the United Kingdom
en.description: The First Strategic Dialogue between the Maldives and the United Kingdom (UK) at the Senior Officials level was held on 20 February 2023 in Male’, Maldives.
en.body:
The First Strategic Dialogue between the Maldives and the United Kingdom (UK) at the Senior Officials level was held on 20 February 2023 in Male’, Maldives.

The discussions focused on thematic areas including economic and trade cooperation, security cooperation, governance, democracy, human rights and rule of law, environment and climate change, higher education, visas and immigration and regional and international cooperation. Following the discussions, the two countries agreed to establish Maldives-UK working group on maritime security and a working group on trade. A Memorandum of Understanding was also signed to formalise the Ocean Country Partnership Programme under the UK’s Blue Planet Fund.

Both countries, acknowledged the importance of maintaining the momentum of the strong bilateral relations and agreed to strengthen the Maldives-UK relationship through the commencement and annual continuation of the Strategic Dialogue, which will enable both countries to better understand each other’s needs and priorities to achieve mutually beneficial cooperation and bring the bilateral relationship to the next level.   The UK recognised the importance of the Maldives as a valued country of the Commonwealth and Small Island Developing States (SIDS), and both countries agreed to explore ways to strengthen further the Maldives-UK bilateral relationship and explore trade opportunities that benefit both economies and promote sustainable development.

The Maldives and the UK acknowledged the impact of overfishing in many parts of the world on marine population and the ecosystem and agreed to promote sustainable fisheries to preserve vital ocean resources. The Maldives and the UK reaffirmed their commitment to the global fight against illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing. The UK and Maldives agreed to renew efforts to further enhance the trading partnership in sustainable fish.

To strengthen cooperation on education, both sides reaffirmed the importance of continuing to build upon opportunities provided for Maldivians through the Commonwealth and Chevening Scholarships. The Maldives and the UK agreed to work towards increasing the numbers of scholarships offered, in collaboration with the Ministry of Higher Education of Maldives. Discussions were also held on supporting the visa process for Maldivian students studying in the UK.

Both countries recognised the importance of people-to-people exchanges in promoting mutual understanding between the two countries. They expressed their commitment to increase the levels of visitor arrivals from the UK to the Maldives, and to strengthen collaboration at local levels, promote cultural cooperation, and conduct friendly exchanges between the two countries.

The Maldives and the UK also emphasized the significance of developing cooperation, particularly on countering terrorism, and the prevention of violent extremism. The Maldives shared the progress it has made in implementing the National Action Plan on Preventing and Countering Violent Extremism and addressed security vulnerabilities and priority areas including maritime security and domain awareness, defence cooperation, interagency operability for attack-response and in delivering successful counterterrorism prosecutions. The Maldives expressed gratitude for the continuous assistance offered by the UK through initiatives such as providing technical assistance for the Joint Interagency Operations Centre (JIOC), counter terrorism live exercises and trainings. Both countries agreed to expand the existing partnership.

The UK welcomed Maldives’ commitment towards consolidation of democratic governance, strengthening the rule of law and promotion and protection of human rights. The UK reiterated its commitment to continue supporting the Maldives in its endeavours to consolidate democracy and emphasized the importance of continuing these reforms.

On climate change, both sides stressed the importance of working together to ensure the success of the UNFCCC as the primary international, intergovernmental forum for negotiating the global response to climate change. Both countries expressed commitment to working together, and with other Parties, to strengthen the effective implementation of the Paris Agreement, and acknowledged the existential challenges of climate change and biodiversity in relation to humanity, as discussed in the COP15, COP26 and COP27. Both countries noted the establishment of the loss and damage fund at COP27 and discussed on cooperating to operationalise the fund at the earliest. The Maldives thanked the UK for its leadership at COP26, in Glasgow, Scotland, and reaffirmed Maldives’ commitment to work with UK in addressing climate change. The UK also commended the role of Maldives in COP27 in bridging the differences and ensuring that the deliberations moved forward.

The two countries exchanged views on the Indian Ocean Region, including maritime security, and agreed to continue to strengthen cooperation at various platforms including multilateral fora such as the Commonwealth and the United Nations. The UK commended the positive contributions made by Abdulla Shahid, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives in his capacity as the President of the 76th Session of the United Nations General Assembly and congratulated him for the successful completion of his term.

The UK congratulated the Maldives on its election to the United Nations Human Rights Council for 2023-2025 and expressed their willingness to continue the close communication and consultation on human rights issues.

The First Strategic Dialogue between the Maldives and UK was held in a hybrid format. The discussions from the Maldives side were led by Dr. Hala Hameed, Secretary Bilateral at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The Maldives delegation was comprised of senior officials of the Government including the President’s Office, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Defence, Ministry of Home Affairs, Attorney General’s Office, Ministry of Higher Education, Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation, Ministry of Economic Development, Ministry of Tourism, Ministry of Fisheries, Marine Resources and Agriculture, Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Technology, Maldives Police Service, National Counter Terrorism Centre, Aviation Security Command and National Security Advisors Office.

The discussions from the United Kingdom were led by Ben Mellor, Director, India and Indian Ocean Directorate at the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office. The UK was represented by senior officials from Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, Ministry of Defence and Department for Transport.

en.title: Newly appointed High Commissioner of Canada to the Maldives calls on the Foreign Minister
en.description: Newly appointed High Commissioner of Canada to the Maldives calls on the Foreign Minister
en.body:
Newly appointed High Commissioner of Canada to the Maldives calls on the Foreign Minister

The newly appointed High Commissioner of Canada to the Maldives, Eric Walsh called on the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid, today.

During the meeting held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Minister Shahid congratulated High Commissioner Walsh on his appointment and reflected on the close and cordial relations between the Maldives and Canada. Minister Shahid and High Commissioner Walsh also discussed ways to further increase the collaboration between the two countries in areas of mutual interest such as climate action, democracy and good governance, and global peace and security.

High Commissioner Walsh expressed the commitment of the Canadian Government to find new avenues for cooperation including increasing people-to-people ties.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by Foreign Secretary Ahmed Latheef, Secretary, Bilateral Dr. Hala Hameed, Secretary Economic Cooperation Dr. Hussain Niyaaz, Joint Secretary Shiuneen Rasheed and Desk Officer Saifulla Waleed.

en.title: The newly appointed Ambassador of Slovenia to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.description: The newly appointed Ambassador of Slovenia to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.body:
The newly appointed Ambassador of Slovenia to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs

The newly appointed Ambassador of Slovenia to the Maldives, Her Excellency Mateja Vodeb Ghosh paid a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, today.

Minister Shahid welcomed Ambassador and congratulated her on becoming the first Ambassador to present credentials as Ambassador of Slovenia to the Maldives. During the meeting, Minister Shahid and Ambassador Ghosh emphasized the long-standing bilateral relations between the two countries and discussed ways to tackle climate change and promote sustainable development.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by State Minister Ahmed Khaleel, Foreign Secretary Ahmed Latheef, Secretary Bilateral Dr. Hala Hameed, Secretary Economic Cooperation Dr. Hussain Niyaaz, Joint Secretary Shiuneen Rasheed and Chief General Service Officer Lujaina Thasneema.

en.title: Maldives to host the First Maldives-UK Strategic Dialogue
en.description: Maldives to host the First Maldives-UK Strategic Dialogue
en.body:
Maldives to host the First Maldives-UK Strategic Dialogue

The First Maldives – UK Strategic Dialogue will be held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on 20 February 2023 in a hybrid format, at Senior Official level. This dialogue aims to facilitate open and constructive engagement between the Maldives and the United Kingdom and to further strengthen the existing ties of friendship and cooperation between the two countries.

The thematic areas of discussion of this year’s meeting will be on economic and trade cooperation, security cooperation, governance, democracy, human rights and rule of law, environment and climate change, higher education, visas and immigration and regional and international cooperation.

The Maldives delegation will be led by Secretary – Bilateral, Dr. Hala Hameed. Senior officials from the President’s Office, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Defence, Ministry of Home Affairs, Attorney General’s Office, Ministry of Higher Education, Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation, Ministry of Economic Development, Ministry of Tourism, Ministry of Fisheries, Marine Resources and Agriculture, Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Technology, Maldives Police Service, National Counter Terrorism Centre, Aviation Security Command and National Security Advisors Office will participate in this meeting.

The delegation from the United Kingdom will be led by Ben Mellor, Director, India and Indian Ocean Directorate at the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office. Senior Officials from the UK’s Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, Ministry of Defence and Department for Transport will participate in the meeting as well.

en.description: Newly appointed Non-Resident High Commissioner of Namibia to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs

Newly appointed Non-Resident High Commissioner of Namibia to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs

The newly appointed Non-Resident High Commissioner of the Republic of Namibia to the Republic of Maldives, His Excellency Gabriel P. Sinimbo paid a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid, today.

During the meeting held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs this afternoon, Minister Shahid welcomed the High Commissioner and congratulated him on presenting credentials as the Non-Resident High Commissioner of Namibia to Maldives. Minister expressed confidence that the relationship between the Maldives and Namibia will grow stronger in the years ahead. Minister also exchanged ideas to further enhance the bilateral ties and cooperation between Maldives and Namibia in areas of mutual interest.

High Commissioner Sinimbo thanked the Minister for the warm welcome and expressed his commitment to work closely with the Government and the people of Maldives to further strengthen the friendship between the two countries.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by Foreign Secretary Ahmed Latheef, Secretary Bilateral Dr. Hala Hameed, Secretary Economic Cooperation Dr Hussain Niyaaz and Director, Ahmed Fazeel.

en.title: Newly appointed Ambassador of Mongolia to the Maldives calls on Foreign Minister Shahid
en.description: Newly appointed Ambassador of Mongolia to the Maldives calls on Foreign Minister Shahid
en.body:
Newly appointed Ambassador of Mongolia to the Maldives calls on Foreign Minister Shahid

The newly appointed Ambassador of Mongolia to the Maldives, Ganbold Dambajav, paid a courtesy call on Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid today, following the Presentation of Credentials to His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, at a ceremony held at the President’s Office this morning.

During the meeting held in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Minister Shahid congratulated Ambassador Dambajav on his appointment and exchanged views on further strengthening the existing bilateral relations between the Maldives and Mongolia. Including signing of a visa exemption agreement between the two countries. Both Minister Shahid and Ambassador Dambajav also reaffirmed their commitment to continue working closely in the multilateral arena.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by Foreign Secretary Ahmed Latheef, Secretary Bilateral Dr. Hala Hameed, Secretary Economic Cooperation Dr. Hussain Niyaaz, Additional Secretary Amin Javed Faizal, Senior Under Secretary Fathimath Naeema and Assistant Director Khadeejath Nizwee Rasheed.

en.body:
Newly appointed Ambassador of Serbia to the Maldives calls on Foreign Minister Shahid

The newly appointed Ambassador of Serbia to the Maldives, His Excellency Sinisa Pavic paid a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, today.

Minister Shahid and Ambassador Pavic strengthening bilateral and multilateral relations between the Maldives and Serbia and emphasized the need for further cooperation to expand economic ties between the two countries, including increasing trade and investment.

en.title: The newly appointed Ambassador of the Russian Federation to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs

en.body:
The newly appointed Ambassador of the Russian Federation to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs

Ambassador Dzhagaryan assured the Minister of his commitment to work with the Government of Maldives to further strengthen bilateral relations between Maldives and Russia during his tenure.

en.description: The newly appointed Ambassador of Hellenic Republic to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs

The newly appointed Ambassador of Hellenic Republic to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs

The newly appointed Non-Resident Ambassador of Hellenic Republic to the Republic of Maldives, His Excellency Dimitrios Loannou has paid a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, today.

Minister Shahid welcomed Ambassador Loannou and congratulated him on presenting credentials as the Non-Resident Ambassador of Greece to Maldives. Minister Shahid expressed his confidence that the relationship and cooperation that exists between the Maldives and Greece would continue to strengthen in the years to come.

Ambassador Loannou expressed his willingness to work together with the Government of Maldives to strengthen the relations in the bilateral and multilateral fora.

en.description: The newly appointed Ambassador of the France to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.body:
The newly appointed Ambassador of the France to Maldives calls on the Minister of Foreign Affairs

The newly appointed Ambassador of France to the Maldives, His Excellency Jean-François Pactet paid a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, today.

During the meeting Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid and Ambassador Jean-François Pactet focused on various issues of mutual interest such as trade, tourism and collaboration on global challenges and reiterated their commitment to enhancing the existing friendly relations between the two countries.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by Foreign Secretary Ahmed Latheef, Secretary Bilateral Dr. Hala Hameed, Secretary Economic Cooperation Dr. Hussain Niyaaz, Joint Secretary Shiuneen Rasheed and Assistant Director Fathmath Lamya Imthiyaz.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to The Gambia
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to The Gambia
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to The Gambia

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, H.E. Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to H.E. Dr. Mamadou Tangara, Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and Gambians Abroad, on the occasion of the Independence Day of the Republic of The Gambia.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It is my pleasure to extend warm felicitations and best wishes, to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of The Gambia on the joyous occasion of your Independence Day.

It is my earnest hope that the ties of friendship between our two countries will continue to flourish. Let me also convey my personal best wishes for Your Excellency’s good health, and for continued peace, progress and prosperity to the people of The Gambia.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Finland presents credentials to the President of Finland
en.description: Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Finland presents credentials to the President of Finland
en.body:
Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Finland presents credentials to the President of Finland

Ambassador of the Republic of Maldives to the Federal Republic of Germany, Aishath Shaan Shakir, presented her Letter of Credence to Sauli Niinistö, President of the Republic of Finland as the Non-Resident Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the Republic of Maldives to the Republic of Finland at a ceremony held at the Presidential Palace in Helsinki today.

During the Credential Ceremony, President Niinistö welcomed Ambassador Shaan and wished her success in undertaking her duties. Ambassador Shaan expressed gratitude and conveyed personal greetings and warm felicitations from President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih to the President, the Government, and the people of Finland. She also expressed her commitment to furthering existing bilateral relations and close cooperation between the two countries.

During her visit to Finland, Ambassador Shaan was briefed by Pekka Puustinen, Under-Secretary of State (Internal and External Services) at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Finland, on the current national and international issues of interest.

Ambassador Shaan was accompanied by Counsellor Umaira Mohamed.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends State Restoration Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Lithuania
en.description: Minister Shahid sends State Restoration Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Lithuania
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends State Restoration Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Lithuania

Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sent a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Lithuania, Gabrielius Landsbergis, on the occasion of the 105th Anniversary of the Lithuanian State Restoration Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It is my pleasure to convey warm greetings and good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the friendly people of Lithuania on the joyous occasion of your State Restoration Day.

It is my earnest hope that the amicable ties between Maldives and Lithuania will continue to grow stronger and more robust in the years to come.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Visa Facilitation arrangements for ITB Berlin 2023
en.description: Visa Facilitation arrangements for ITB Berlin 2023
en.body:
Visa Facilitation arrangements for ITB Berlin 2023

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs wishes to inform that the Ministry, in coordination with the Embassy of Germany and the VFS Center in the Maldives has made arrangements to facilitate visa acquisition for those who are participating in the ITB fair to be held in Berlin, Germany from 7 to 8 March 2023.

In this regard, those who have not acquired a visa or those who have not shared their details with Maldives Marketing and Public Relations Corporation (MMPRC) to date, kindly email the following details to maudhoodha@visitmaldives.com.

1. Full Name
2. Designation
3. Passport data page copy including Schengen visa page of those who have acquired Schengen visa before.
4. Contact number
5. Email address

We also wish to inform that the VFS center in the Maldives will contact those who have shared their details with MMPRC to inform date and time of their visa appointment.

If you have any further inquiries related to the ITB visa, you may email your query to consular@foreign.gov.mv

en.description: Minister Shahid sends Statehood Day greetings to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Serbia
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Statehood Day greetings to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Serbia

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Ivica Dačić, Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia, on the occasion of the Statehood Day of Serbia.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government and the people of the Republic of Maldives, it gives me great pleasure to extend warm felicitations to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Serbia, on the jubilant occasion of the Statehood Day of the Republic of Serbia.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest considerations”

en.title: New UNICEF Representative presents Letter of Appointment to Minister Shahid
en.description: New UNICEF Representative presents Letter of Appointment to Minister Shahid
en.body:
New UNICEF Representative presents Letter of Appointment to Minister Shahid

The new UNICEF Representative to the Maldives, Dr. Edward Addai presented his Letter of Appointment to the Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid today.

During the meeting held following the presentation, Minister Shahid and the Representative discussed the role of UNICEF in the Maldives, in areas on child protection, maternal and child heath, immunization, nutrition, pre and primary education and social inclusion.

The discussion also highlighted the progress in the implementation of the UNICEF Country Programme Document which supports the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF 2022-2026).

UNICEF has been instrumental, especially on the areas of protection of the rights of the child which is a key priority area of the Government of Maldives.

en.title: Maldives donates 1 million cans of tuna to Türkiye and Syria
en.description: Maldives donates 1 million cans of tuna to Türkiye and Syria
en.body:
Maldives donates 1 million cans of tuna to Türkiye and Syria

The Maldivian Government has decided to donate 1 million cans of tuna to the people of Türkiye and Syria following the devastating earthquake that hit the region on 6 February 2023. Both countries will receive 500,000 cans respectively from the donation.

This decision was made by His Excellency Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, President of the Republic of Maldives, in order to extend humanitarian and relief aid to the distressed people in the region.

Foreign Minister Shahid said the following, while speaking on the donation.

“This donation is a demonstration of our solidarity with the people of Türkiye and Syria. We hope that this small contribution will bring a sense of comfort and support to those affected.

Our prayers are with our sisters and brothers as they navigate through these challenging times. “

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid participates in the virtual COVID-19 Global Action Plan Ministerial Meeting
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid participates in the virtual COVID-19 Global Action Plan Ministerial Meeting
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid participates in the virtual COVID-19 Global Action Plan Ministerial Meeting

The Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid participated and delivered remarks at the virtual COVID-19 Global Action Plan Ministerial Meeting hosted by the Secretary of State of the United States of America, Antony Blinken today.

In his remarks, Minister Shahid reflected on the achievements of the GAP initiative, which was instrumental in providing vaccines to vulnerable countries and ensuring mechanisms were in place for vaccines to be administered.

Highlighting the importance of preventing, detecting, and responding to future pandemics, Minister Shahid emphasized the importance of continuing the work to support closing the booster gap, vaccinating the most vulnerable and at-risk within the population, diversifying the production of vaccines, and actively supporting new producers and platforms for vaccines, and anti-viral medicines.

Minister Shahid also briefed the partners on the measures taken by the Government of Maldives to vaccinate 85 percent of the resident population including locals and migrants, irrespective of their status or origin.

Before concluding his statement, Minister Shahid thanked Secretary Blinken, the Government of the United States of America for their leadership in this initiative, and other partner countries and organizations in formalising assistance mechanisms to manage the continuing impacts of the pandemic, especially for vulnerable countries.

The GAP partners re-convened today to assess the work of the GAP, identify remaining barriers to curbing the acute phase of the COVID-19 pandemic, and reflect upon lessons learned to promote future collaboration to respond to future global health security threats. Along with Minister Shahid, Foreign Ministers and senior officials from Japan, Bangladesh, Germany, WHO, Republic of Korea, European Union, Oman, South Africa, Colombia, Senegal, Italy, Belize, Jamaica, Argentina, Costa Rica, African Union, India, Thailand, Morocco, Saudi Arabia, Kenya, Norway, Spain, Australia, Israel, Canada, New Zealand, the United Kingdom and Indonesia also participated at the Ministerial Meeting.

en.title: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Foreign Minister of Grenada
en.description: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Foreign Minister of Grenada
en.body:
Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Foreign Minister of Grenada

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends message of felicitations to Joseph Andall, Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Business and CARICOM Affairs of Grenada, on the occasion of their Independence Day. Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives, and on my own behalf, it gives me great pleasure to extend warm greetings and felicitations coupled with my best wishes for the good health and further progress and development of the friendly people of Grenada, on this jubilant occasion of your Independence Day.

I am confident that the ties of friendship and cooperation between our two countries will be further enhanced in the years ahead.

Please accept, Your Excellency, our best wishes for the continued peace and prosperity of Grenada.”

en.title: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid sends Waitangi Day greetings to Foreign Minister of New Zealand
en.description: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid sends Waitangi Day greetings to Foreign Minister of New Zealand
en.body:
Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid sends Waitangi Day greetings to Foreign Minister of New Zealand

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Nanaia Mahuta, Minister of Foreign Affairs and Local Government of New Zealand, on the occasion of Waitangi Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

"On behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives and on my own behalf, it gives me great pleasure to extend best wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of New Zealand as you commemorate the anniversary of the signing of the Treaty of Waitangi.

The relationship between the Maldives and New Zealand is one based in mutual trust, common values, and unwavering friendship. I am confident that the close relations of friendship and co-operation that exist between our two countries will continue to reach greater heights in the coming years.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration and good wishes for your personal health and wellbeing, as well as for the progress and prosperity of the friendly people of New Zealand."

en.title: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Türkiye
en.description: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Türkiye
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Türkiye

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Türkiye , Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu, following the powerful earthquake that struck Southern Turkiye today.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“I am deeply saddened to hear the news of the horrific earthquake that struck Southeastern Anatolia of Türkiye, with aftershocks in numerous other cities.

On behalf of the Government and the people of the Maldives, I would like to convey our heartfelt condolences to the families who lost their loved ones as well as everyone who has been affected by this tragedy.

Our sincere prayers are with the people of Türkiye, and we hope the efforts of the rescue teams continue swiftly and successfully."

en.title: Minister Shahid sends condolences on the passing of the former President of Pakistan
en.description: Minister Shahid sends condolences on the passing of the former President of Pakistan
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends condolences on the passing of the former President of Pakistan

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sent a message of condolence to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan on the passing of the former President of Pakistan.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“Your Excellency,

It is with deep sorrow that I heard the news of the passing away of His Excellency Parvez Musharraf, former President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. His Excellency Musharraf will be fondly remembered for the services he had rendered to his country.

At this time of national grief, the Government and the people of the Maldives join me in extending our sincere condolences to Your Excellency and the brotherly people of Pakistan.

I pray to Almighty Allah to accept His Excellency’s good deeds and grant the highest ranks of Jannah. ‘Surely to Allah do we belong and surely to Him is our return.’”

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Sri Lanka
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Sri Lanka
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Sri Lanka

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to His Excellency M.U.M. Ali Sabry, P.C., MP, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, on the occasion of Sri Lanka’s Independence Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It is my distinct honour to visit Sri Lanka and attend the official celebrations held on the auspicious occasion of its 75th anniversary of independence. I wish to convey the warm greetings and sincere good wishes of the Government and the people of Maldives, and on my own behalf, to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of Sri Lanka on this momentous occasion.

I remain committed to enhancing the close bilateral cooperation between the Maldives and Sri Lanka and upholding the deep ties of friendship that have always existed between our countries, which I am confident will continue to strengthen in the years to come.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration."

en.title: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid meets Minister of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka
en.description: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid meets Minister of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka
en.body:
Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid meets Minister of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka

Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid met with His Excellency M.U.M. Ali Sabry, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka today.

During the meeting, Minister Shahid and Minister Sabry exchanged views on strengthening existing areas, and exploring new avenues of cooperation, particularly on trade, investment, education and culture. Minister Shahid thanked Minister Sabry for the Sri Lankan Government’s willingness to ease the procedure for obtaining visa for Maldivian students under the age of 18 on a reciprocal basis.

Following the meeting, the two Ministers witnessed the signing of the ‘Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of Sri Lanka on Cooperation on Immigration Matters’. Minister Shahid noted that the agreement signed today is mutually beneficial and assist the two countries in managing border security and enhance people-to-people contact between Maldives and Sri Lanka.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by the Deputy Majority Leader of the Parliament, Honorable MP Hussain Shaheem, Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Mr. Ahmed Khaleel, High Commissioner of the Maldives to the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, His Excellency Ali Faiz, Secretary Bilateral, Her Excellency Dr. Hala Hameed, Controller General of the Maldives Immigration, Mr. Mohamed Ahmed Hussain, Deputy High Commissioner, Ms. Fathimath Ghina, Assistant Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ms. Aishath Fareena and Second Secretary, Ms. Aminath Warudha.

Foreign Minister Shahid is on an official visit to Sri Lanka on the invitation of Sri Lankan Foreign Minister Sabry to attend the celebrations of the 75th Anniversary of the Independence of Sri Lanka.

en.title: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid arrives in Sri Lanka to attend the celebrations to mark the 75th anniversary of Independence of Sri Lanka
en.description: Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid arrives in Sri Lanka to attend the celebrations to mark the 75th anniversary of Independence of Sri Lanka
en.body:
Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid arrives in Sri Lanka to attend the celebrations to mark the 75th anniversary of Independence of Sri Lanka

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid arrived on an official visit to Sri Lanka on the invitation of His Excellency M.U.M. Ali Sabry, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka, to attend the celebrations for the 75th Anniversary of the Independence of Sri Lanka.

During the visit, Minister Shahid will pay courtesy calls on His Excellency Ranil Wickremesinghe, President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, His Excellency Dinesh Gunawardena, Prime Minister of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and His Excellency M.U.M. Ali Sabry, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka.

Minister Shahid will also visit the High Commission of the Maldives in Sri Lanka and meet with the Maldivian community living in Sri Lanka.

Minister Shahid is accompanied by the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Mr Ahmed Khaleel; Secretary Bilateral, Her Excellency Dr Hala Hameed; Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Mr. Hussain Jahhaz; and Assistant Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ms. Aishath Fareena.

en.title: High Commissioner of Maldives to Sri Lanka H.E. Ali Faiz Presents Credentials to the President of Sri Lanka
en.description: High Commissioner of Maldives to Sri Lanka H.E. Ali Faiz Presents Credentials to the President of Sri Lanka
en.body:
High Commissioner of Maldives to Sri Lanka H.E. Ali Faiz Presents Credentials to the President of Sri Lanka

The High Commissioner of the Republic of Maldives to the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, His Excellency Ali Faiz presented his Letter of Credence to the President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, His Excellency Ranil Wickremesinghe, at a ceremony held this afternoon at the President’s House, Kandy.

During the ensuing courtesy call, High Commissioner Faiz expressed his gratitude for the honour to present his Letter of Credence and serve as the High Commissioner of Maldives to Sri Lanka. High Commissioner Faiz also conveyed greetings from His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih and the people of Maldives to the President and the people of Sri Lanka. While noting the historical and close bonds between both the two countries, High Commissioner Faiz thanked the Sri Lankan Government for its unwavering support and assistance to the Maldivians residing in Sri Lanka. High Commissioner further commended the leadership of H.E  Wickremesinghe and the Government of Sri Lanka in tackling the current economic crisis and expressed hope for the country’s recovery at the earliest.

High Commissioner Faiz expressed his commitment to work closely with the Government of Sri Lanka with renewed focus on further strengthening the existing bilateral relations between the two countries, in both bilateral and multilateral spheres.

His Excellency Ranil Wickremesinghe, President of Sri Lanka, congratulated High Commissioner Faiz on the assumption of his duties as High Commissioner of Maldives to Sri Lanka. The President provided his assurance that his Government will work closely with the Government of Maldives for the benefit of the two countries and its peoples.

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid sends Independence day greetings to Foreign Minister of Nauru
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid sends Independence day greetings to Foreign Minister of Nauru
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid sends Independence day greetings to Foreign Minister of Nauru

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to His Excellency Russ Joseph Kun, President and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Nauru, on the occasion of Independence Day of Nauru.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

"On behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives and on my own behalf, I wish to extend warm felicitations and congratulations to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Nauru, on the occasion of the 55th anniversary of your Independence Day.

The Maldives and Nauru as Small Island Developing States share many similarities. I am confident that our cooperation in the multilateral fora will continue to strengthen our relations in the years to come.

Please accept, Excellency, my best wishes for your good health and happiness, and for continued peace, progress and prosperity of people of Nauru."

en.title: Maldives underscores the importance of collaborative approaches in solving common challenges at the 2023 ECOSOC Partnership Forum
en.description: Maldives underscores the importance of collaborative approaches in solving common challenges at the 2023 ECOSOC Partnership Forum
en.body:
Maldives underscores the importance of collaborative approaches in solving common challenges at the 2023 ECOSOC Partnership Forum

The Permanent Representative of Maldives to the United Nations, Ambassador Thilmeeza Hussain, delivered a statement at the 2023 Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC) Partnership Forum on accelerating the recovery from the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) and the full implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development at all levels, on 31 January 2023.

In her statement, Ambassador Thilmeeza emphasised that the COVID-19 pandemic wreaked havoc on Maldives’ economy and demonstrated the impacts of a steep and sudden contraction on its critical tourism industry. She stated that Maldives recognized that economic recovery required even and fair vaccination; increased health spending and strong measures in place to contain the outbreak; while supporting vulnerable households and businesses most affected by the crises. She further stressed that the success of Maldives’ actions strongly depended on the partnerships forged under the leadership of President Solih – between all levels of Government from national to local; with the private sector and civil society and media; and with the strong support of our international partners including the United Nations. In addition, Ambassador Thilmeeza said that the pandemic compounded aspects of gender equality as women bore the brunt from the economic fallout of the pandemic, and reiterated Maldives’ call that sustainable development cannot be achieved without the full, equal, effective and meaningful participation of women in all facets of life.

The Partnership Forum is an annual meeting held under the auspices of ECOSOC, bringing together governments, the private and non-profit sectors, UN entities and civil society to collaborate and foster discussion on how partnerships can advance international development.

dv.title: ސްވިޑެން، ނެދަލެންޑްސް އަދި ޑެންމާކްގައި މުޞްޙަފް އެންދުމާ ގުޅިގެން ބޭއްވި އޯ.އައި.ސީ. ގެ އެގްޒެކެޓިވް ކޮމިޓީގެ އެކްސްޓްރަ އޯރޑިނަރީ ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއިން ބައިވެރިވެއްޖެ
dv.description: ސްވިޑުން، ނެދަލެންޑްސް އަދި ޑެންމާކުގައި މުޞްޙަފް އެންދުމާ ގުޅިގެން އޯ.އައި.ސީ.ގެ ސްޓޭންޑް ފާޅުކުރުމަށްޓަކައި ސައުދި އަރަބިއްޔާގެ ޖިއްދާގައި ހުންނަ އޯގަނައިޒޭޝަން އޮފް އިސްލާމިކް ކޯޕަރޭޝަން (އޯ.އައި.ސީ.) ގެ މައި މަރުކަޒުގައި މިއަދު ބޭއްވި އޯ.އައި.ސީ. ގެ އެގްޒެކެޓިވް ކޮމިޓީގެ އެކްސްޓްރަ އޯރޑިނަރީ…
dv.body:
ސްވިޑުން، ނެދަލެންޑްސް އަދި ޑެންމާކުގައި މުޞްޙަފް އެންދުމާ ގުޅިގެން އޯ.އައި.ސީ.ގެ ސްޓޭންޑް ފާޅުކުރުމަށްޓަކައި ސައުދި އަރަބިއްޔާގެ ޖިއްދާގައި ހުންނަ އޯގަނައިޒޭޝަން އޮފް އިސްލާމިކް ކޯޕަރޭޝަން (އޯ.އައި.ސީ.) ގެ މައި މަރުކަޒުގައި މިއަދު ބޭއްވި އޯ.އައި.ސީ. ގެ އެގްޒެކެޓިވް ކޮމިޓީގެ އެކްސްޓްރަ އޯރޑިނަރީ ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ފަރާތުން އޯ.އައި.ސީ. އަށް ކަނޑައަޅުއްވާފައި ހުންނަވާ ދާއިމީ މަންދޫބު އަދި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ފަރާތުން ސައުދީ އަރަބިއްޔާއަށް ކަނޑައަޅުއްވާފައި ހުންނަވާ ސަފީރު އަލްފާޟިލް މުޙައްމަދު ޚަލީލް ބައިވެރިވެ ވަޑައިގަތެވެ.

މި ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި މުޞްޙަފްއެންދި މައްސަލަ ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރުން ކުށްވެރި ކުރައްވައި، އަމަނިކުފާނު ވަނީ ވާހަކަފުޅު ދައްކަވާފައެވެ. އަދި އެ މަނިކުފާނުގެ ވާހަކަފުޅުގައި މިފަދަ ޢަމަލުތަކަކީ ދުނިޔޭގެ އެކި ކަންކޮޅު ތަކުގައި ތިބި އެތައް މިލިއަން މުސްލިމުންގެ ދީނީ އިޚްސާސްތަކަށް ގެއްލުންލިބޭ، ވަރަށް ދަށުދަރަޖައިގެ ޢަމަލެއްކަމަށް ފާހަގަ ކުރެއްވިއެވެ. އަދި މިފަދަ ކަންކަމުގެ ސަބަބުން މުޖުތަމަޢުގެ ސުލްހަމަސަލަސްކަމަށް ހުރަސްއެޅި ނަފުރަތާއި ހަރުކަށި ފިކުރު އިތުރުވުމަށް މަގުފަހިވެގެން ދާނެކަންވެސް އެމަނިކުފާނުގެ ވާހަކަފުޅުގައި ފާހަގަ ކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

en.title: Ambassador of Poland to Maldives pays a farewell call on Minister Shahid
en.description: Ambassador of Poland to Maldives pays a farewell call on Minister Shahid
en.body:
Ambassador of Poland to Maldives pays a farewell call on Minister Shahid

The Ambassador of the Republic of Poland to the Republic of Maldives, Adam Burakowski, paid a farewell call on Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid, today.

Foreign Minister Shahid congratulated the Ambassador on the completion of his successful tenure and expressed appreciation for his role in strengthening the bilateral ties between Maldives and Poland. Both Minister Shahid and Ambassador Burakowski reviewed some of the key bilateral cooperation areas between the two countries, including trade and economic ties, tourism cooperation, education, Maldives-EU partnership, Schengen visa facilitation, and multilateral issues of mutual importance.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by State Minister Ahmed Khaleel, Secretary Bilateral Dr. Hala Hameed, Joint Secretary Shiuneen Rasheed and Assistant Director Fathmath Lamya Imthiyaz.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Pakistan
en.description: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Pakistan
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Pakistan

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid has sent a message of condolence to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Pakistan, Bilawal Bhutto Zardari following the suicide attack in Peshawar Mosque in Pakistan, today.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“I am deeply saddened to learn that many people have been killed and several more injured in the terrorist attack targeting a mosque in the city of Peshawar in Pakistan today.

The Maldives strongly condemns this heinous terrorist attack and stands firm in support of the global fight against all forms of violence and terrorism that aims to disrupt peace, security and stability.

The Government and the people of Maldives join me in extending our deepest sympathies to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Pakistan especially the bereaved families and wish all those injured a speedy recovery.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Pakistan
en.description: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Pakistan
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Pakistan

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid has sent a message of condolence to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Pakistan, Bilawal Bhutto Zardari following the loss of lives due to a bus crash and a capsizing of a boat in Pakistan, today.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“I am deeply shocked and saddened to learn of the tragic bus crash in Lasbela district of Balochistan, and the capsizing of a boat in the Tanda Dam Lake, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province today, both of which caused the loss of many lives including several children.

At this time of distress, the Government and the people of Maldives join me in extending our deepest condolences to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Pakistan. Our prayers are with the bereaved families, and we wish for the quick and complete recovery of the injured.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Australia Day greetings
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Australia Day greetings
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Australia Day greetings

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends message of felicitations to Senator the Hon Penny Wong, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Commonwealth of Australia on the occasion of Australia Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives and on my own behalf, I would like to extend warm greetings and sincere best wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of the Commonwealth of Australia, on the occasion of Australia Day.

It is with great appreciation I note that Australia has played a vital role in the development trajectory of the Maldives. A strong testament of this is the extensive collaboration we have on multitude of areas and commonality on many issues – including sustainable development challenges, good governance, human rights, our mutually beneficial and strategic partnership, and Australia’s great contribution to the training of our Youth-future of our nation.

As we commemorate the 49th Anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties, I see great strides of success built on strong bonds of friendship and I look forward to deepening this mutually beneficial partnership in the future.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest considerations.”

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Republic Day greetings to India
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Republic Day greetings to India
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Republic Day greetings to India

Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sent a message of felicitations to the Minister of External Affairs of India, Dr. S. Jaishankar, on the occasion of the 74th Republic Day of India.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It is with much pleasure that I convey to Your Excellency and the friendly people of the Republic of India, warm felicitations, and good wishes on behalf of the Government and people of Maldives, on the auspicious occasion of the Republic Day of India.

The enactment of the Constitution of India, 74 years ago laid the foundation of democracy in India. This important milestone has led the way for growth and development of the nation and for the people of India. For a country so rich in diversity, the success of the Constitution itself is impressive and inspirational for many nations.

Relations between India and Maldives is both traditional and historical. India has always been at the forefront when it came to providing support to the Maldives, both bilaterally and at multilateral forums. India is a preferred economic and strategic partner for the Maldives as cooperation between our two countries is based on mutual trust and our shared commitment for the development of our nations and region. The Maldives-India relationship is undoubtedly, a priority to the Government, and I am convinced that it will continue to grow to new heights.

I also wish to take this opportunity to convey my personal good wishes for your health and well-being, and for the continued progress and prosperity of the friendly people of India.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Ambassador of Maldives to Belgium, Omar Abdul Razzak presents his Letter of Credence to the President of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen
en.description: Ambassador of Maldives to Belgium presents his Letter of Credence to the President of the European Commission
en.body:
Ambassador of Maldives to Belgium presents his Letter of Credence to the President of the European Commission

The newly appointed Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Maldives to the European Union, Omar Abdul Razzak, presented his Letter of Credence to the President of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, this afternoon. The ceremony was held at the Headquarters of the European Commission in Brussels.

During the meeting that followed the ceremony, Ambassador Omar conveyed personal greetings and best wishes from President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih. He also stressed on the close ties between the Maldives and EU and reiterated the commitment of continuing to foster the excellent bilateral relations and close cooperation with the EU.

President of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, in her remarks, congratulated Ambassador Omar for his appointment and re-affirmed the positive and growing momentum in the Maldives-EU relations.

en.title: Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Norway presents credentials to the King of Norway
en.description: Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Norway presents credentials to the King of Norway
en.body:
Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Norway presents credentials to the King of Norway

Ambassador of the Republic of Maldives to the Federal Republic of Germany, Her Excellency Aishath Shaan Shakir, presented her Letter of Credence to His Majesty King Harald V, King of Norway as the Non-Resident Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the Republic of Maldives to the Kingdom of Norway at a ceremony held at the Royal Palace in Oslo today.

During the Credential Ceremony, Ambassador Shaan conveyed personal greetings and warm felicitations from His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih to the King, the Government, and the people of Norway. She further expressed her commitment to strengthening existing bilateral relations and close cooperation between the two countries.

During her visit to Norway, Ambassador Shaan held discussions with Mr. Vegar Brynildsen, Deputy Secretary General at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway and senior officials of the Ministry to explore potential avenues of collaboration in areas such as climate change, sustainable development, waste management, blue economy and education among others.

Ambassador Shaan also paid a courtesy call on Her Excellency Maw Maw, Ambassador of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, and Dean of the Diplomatic Corps in Oslo.

en.title: The 42nd session of the Universal Periodic Review commences today
en.description: The 42nd session of the Universal Periodic Review commences today
en.body:
The 42nd session of the Universal Periodic Review commences today

The 42nd Session of the Universal Periodic Review (UPR) commenced at the Palais des Nations in Geneva, today. The session will continue for a period of two weeks and will conclude on 3 February 2023.

In line with the government’s key policies and priorities, the Maldives delegation will actively engage in this Session of the UPR. It will present constructive recommendations to all 13 States that will be reviewed at the Session. The 13 countries under review are Argentina, Benin, Czechia, Gabon, Ghana, Guatemala, Japan, Republic of Korea, Pakistan, Peru, Sri Lanka, Switzerland, and Zambia.

The Permanent Representative of the Maldives to the United Nations Offices in Geneva His Excellency Dr. Asim Ahmed, in his capacity as the Vice President of the Human Rights Council will be chairing some of the reviews that would take place at this session.

The Maldives delegation for the 42nd Session of the UPR will be led by His Excellency Dr. Asim Ahmed, Permanent Representative of the Maldives to the United Nations Offices at Geneva. The delegation will include Ms. Hawla Ahmed Didi, Deputy Permanent Representative of the Maldives Mission, Mr. Hassan Hussain Shihab, Counsellor at the Maldives Mission, Ms. Aminath Shifaya Ibrahim, Counsellor at the Maldives Mission and Ms. Maryam Fathika Fayaz, Second Secretary at the Maldives Mission.

The UPR is a State-driven process which involves a review of the human rights record of all UN Member States. The process provides the States under review with the opportunity to declare actions taken to improve the human rights situations in their respective countries and allows fellow Member States to provide commendations for these actions and constructive recommendations on how the States can further fulfill their human rights obligations. The UPR mechanism is designed to give equal treatment to every country when their human rights situation is assessed, with the objective of improving human rights situations in all countries.

The UPR Working Group holds three session every year. The Fourth Cycle review of the UPR began in November 2022 and will conclude in 2027.

en.title: Maldives to support India’s candidature to the UN Security Council
en.description: Maldives to support India’s candidature to the UN Security Council
en.body:
Maldives to support India’s candidature to the UN Security Council

The Government of Maldives has decided to support India’s candidature to a non-permanent seat of the United Nations Security Council, for the term 2028-2029, the election for which is scheduled to be held during the eighty-first session of the United Nations General Assembly in June 2027.

The decision to support India was taken following the visit undertaken by the Minister of External Affairs of India, Dr. Subrahmanyam Jaishankar, from 18-19 January 2023 to the Maldives. The Maldives’ strong support for India is rooted in the strong partnership and close bonds of friendship that exists between both countries.

India has continuously demonstrated strong and effective leadership in maintaining international peace and security. India has also been a strong proponent of the values and principles enshrined in the United Nations Charter. The Government of Maldives is confident that India will be a voice for all developing countries on the Security Council, and will continue to make meaningful contributions towards global discourse on peace and security in the years to come.

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid sends Chinese Spring Festival and the New Year greetings to China
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid sends Chinese Spring Festival and the New Year greetings to China
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid sends Chinese Spring Festival and the New Year greetings to China

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of China, Qin Gang on the occasion of the Chinese Spring Festival and the New Year of the Rabbit.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On the joyous occasion of the celebration of the Chinese Spring Festival and the New Year of the Rabbit, I would like to extend warm felicitations and sincere good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the friendly people of China.

I also see this as an occasion to express my appreciation and gratitude for the close cooperation and continued support extended by the Government of the People’s Republic of China over the past 5 decades. As we move beyond the 50th Anniversary of diplomatic relations which we commemorated in 2022, I remain confident that the long-standing ties of friendship and collaboration that we have shared over the past years will continue to deepen and strengthen into the future.

Let me also convey my personal best wishes for Your Excellency’s good health and success, and continued peace, progress and prosperity for the people of China.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Maldives Participated in the Fifth Intersessional Meeting of the Human Rights Council on Human Rights and 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development held in Geneva
en.description: Maldives Participated in the Fifth Intersessional Meeting of the Human Rights Council on Human Rights and 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development held in Geneva
en.body:
Maldives Participated in the Fifth Intersessional Meeting of the Human Rights Council on Human Rights and 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development held in Geneva

The Fifth Intersessional Meeting of the Human Rights Council on Human Rights and 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development was held in Geneva today. The Foreign Minister of Chile Her Excellency. Ms. Antonia Urrejola, the President of the Human Rights Council His Excellency Mr. Václav Bálek and the High Commissioner for Human Rights Mr. Volker Türk addressed the Meeting. The theme of the meeting was “Overcoming multiple crises: realising the SDGs through a human right enhancing economy”.

During the session, Ambassador and Permanent Representative of the Maldives to the UN Office in Geneva, His Excellency Dr. Asim Ahmed, delivered a statement and highlighted that the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development must be the guiding framework to end poverty, to protect the planet, and to ensure peace and security for all. He further stated that the promotion and protection of human rights is one of the integral pillars of the Maldivian foreign policy and as a member of the Human Rights Council, the Maldives will continue to advocate for the promotion and protection of human rights at home and abroad.

The 2023 intersessional meeting is the fifth of a series of inter-sessional meetings of the Human Rights Council on human rights and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. The meeting focused on the importance of integrating human rights into the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for sustainable development and discussed the socio-economic impact of multiple crises in the world today.

en.title: Ceremony held to inaugurate the Foakaidhoo Community Centre
en.description: Ceremony held to inaugurate the Foakaidhoo Community Centre
en.body:
Ceremony held to inaugurate the Foakaidhoo Community Centre

The inauguration of Foakaidhoo Community Centre facilitated under Indian grant assistance was held today in Shaviyani Foakaidhoo. The Community Centre was jointly inaugurated by Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid and Minister of External Affairs of India, Dr. S. Jaishankar.

Speaking at the event, Minister Shahid highlighted that the Community Centre inaugurated today will have a positive impact on the community development of the island as the Centre will open opportunities for community interaction through a range of activities and interests for all age groups. During the Ceremony the Minister of External Affairs of India also delivered a statement.

The Foakaidhoo Community Centre development project is valued at 5.2 million Rufiyaa and has been completed under the Indian grant assistance scheme of 106 million Rufiyaa provided in 2019.

Minister of External Affairs, Dr. Jaishankar is on an Official Visit to Maldives on the invitation of Foreign Minister Abdulla Shahid from 18 to 19 January 2023.

en.title: Minister of External Affairs of India departs from Maldives
en.description: Minister of External Affairs of India departs from Maldives
en.body:
Minister of External Affairs of India departs from Maldives

The Minister of External Affairs of India, Dr. S. Jaishankar departed today from Maafaru International Airport after concluding his two-day Official Visit to the Maldives.

The External Affairs Minister arrived in the Maldives on 18 January 2023 and called on the President of Maldives, Ibrahim Mohamed Solih and met with his counterpart, Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid, where both Ministers reviewed the development cooperation projects and discussed strengthening of collaboration in various avenues. Both Ministers also discussed on the projects currently in various stages of implementation, under the grants and five lines of credit extended to the Government of Maldives, from the Government of India, through the Export Import Bank of India.

The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid and Minister of External Affairs, Dr. Jaishankar witnessed the exchange of three key agreements including the Memorandum of Understanding of 100 million Rufiyaa to undertake additional High Impact Community Development Projects and the Memorandum of Understanding for the establishment of Gaafu Dhaal Gadhoo Sports Complex during a ceremony held in Noonu Manadhoo. Additionally, Memorandum of Understanding on capacity building to facilitate exchanges and co-operative initiative between Maldives National University and Cochin University of Science and Technology was exchanged during the ceremony. During the visit, the Minister of External Affairs also attended the groundbreaking ceremony of Hanimaadhoo International Airport Development Project in Haa Dhaal Hanimaadhoo, being constructed under the Indian line of credit facilitated by the Government of India valued at 136.63 million US dollars. In addition, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives and Minister of External Affairs of India jointly inaugurated the Shaviyani Foakaidhoo Community Centre, a project valued at 5.2 million Rufiyaa completed under the Indian grant assistance scheme of 106 million Rufiyaa provided in 2019.

Both Ministers agreed to further intensify the cooperation and enhance Maldives-India partnership. This visit marked a significant milestone in strengthening the bilateral relations of the two countries. During the visit, Minister of External Affairs also visited Haa Alif Utheemu and toured the historical sites.

Minister of External Affairs was seen off at Maafaru International Airport by the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Khaleel and senior officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

en.title: Maldives delivered a statement at the UNSC Open Debate on the Situation in the Middle East Including the Palestinian Question
en.description: Maldives delivered a statement at the UNSC Open Debate on the Situation in the Middle East Including the Palestinian Question
en.body:
Maldives delivered a statement at the UNSC Open Debate on the Situation in the Middle East Including the Palestinian Question

Deputy Permanent Representative Dr. Ibrahim Zuhuree delivered a statement at the UNSC Open Debate on ‘the Situation in the Middle East Including the Palestinian Question’ on Wednesday, 18 January 2023. The Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process Tor Wennesland briefed the meeting.

In his statement, DPR Zuhuree alerted that on 3rd January, Itamar Ben-Gvir, the recently appointed Israeli National Security Minister, stormed the courtyards of Al-Aqsa Mosque with a large contingent of forces. Emphasizing that the Maldivian Government denounces this highly provocative action, he noted forceful entry violates all norms, escalates tension around the Holy Sites, provokes violence, and threatens to change the identity and legal and historic status quo of Al-Haram Al-Sharif.

DPR Zuhuree stated that Israeli actions, in occupied territories, violate international and humanitarian law and threaten the peace and security of the Middle East. He remarked that the people of Palestine have been suffering under Israeli occupation despite several Security Council resolutions and despite broad international condemnation. “It is critical that the perpetrators of blatant violations of international law and international humanitarian law are held accountable for their actions,” he said.

Further, DPR Zuhuree reiterated Maldives’ steadfast support for any resolution which outlines the formation of an independent and sovereign State of Palestine established on the pre-1967 borders, with East Jerusalem as its capital. He said the Maldives firmly believe this is the only viable solution to ensure an end to the conflict so that the people of both Palestine and Israel can enjoy meaningful and enduring peace and live side by side with dignity.

Concluding his statement, DPR Zuhuree appealed to the UNSC and the international community to undertake urgent efforts to find long-term solutions to improve stability across the region and lay the foundations for lasting peace in the Middle East.

dv.title: އިންޑިއާގެ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް އެކްސްޓަރނަލް އެފެއާޒް ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް ރަސްމީ ދަތުރުފުޅެއްގައި މިއަދު ވަޑައިގެންފި
dv.description: އިންޑިއާގެ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް އެކްސްޓަރނަލް އެފެއާޒް ޑރ. އެސް. ޖައިޝަންކަރު ރަސްމީ ދަތުރުފުޅެއްގައި މިއަދު ރާއްޖެ ވަޑައިގެންފިއެވެ.
dv.body:
އިންޑިއާގެ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް އެކްސްޓަރނަލް އެފެއާޒް ޑރ. އެސް. ޖައިޝަންކަރު ރަސްމީ ދަތުރުފުޅެއްގައި މިއަދު ރާއްޖެ ވަޑައިގެންފިއެވެ.

އެމަނިކުފާނަށް މާފަރު އިންޓަރނޭޝަނަލް އެއާޕޯޓުން މަރުޙަބާ ދެންނެވީ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއާޒް ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދާއި މިނިސްޓްރީ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއާޒް ގެ އިސް އޮފިޝަލުންނާއި، ނ. އަތޮޅު ކައުންސިލް ރައީސް އާއި ނ. މާފަރު ކައުންސިލްގެ މެންބަރުންނެވެ.

އިންޑިއާގެ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް އެކްސްޓަރނަލް އެފެއާޒްގެ މި ދަތުރުފުޅުގައި އިންޑިއާ ސަރުކާރުގެ ލައިން އޮފް ކްރެޑިޓްގެ އެހީގައި ހިންގާ ހަނިމާދޫ އިންޓަރނޭޝަނަލް އެއަރޕޯޓް ޑިވެލޮޕްމަންޓް ޕްރޮޖެކްޓްގެ ޢަމަލީ މަސައްކަތް ފެށުމުގެ ރަސްމިއްޔާތުގައި ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގަންނަވާނެއެވެ. އަދި މި ދަތުރުފުޅުގައި، އިންޑިއާ ސަރުކާރުގެ އެހީގައި ށ.ފޯކައިދޫގައި ޤާއިމް ކުރެވިފައިވާ ށ.ފޯކައިދޫ ކޮމިޔުނިޓީ ސެންޓަރ އިފްތިތާޙް ކުރެއްވުމުގެ ރަސްމިއްޔާތުގައި ބައިވެރިވެ ވަޑައިގަތުމަށް ވަނީ ހަމަޖެހިފައެވެ.

މި ދަތުރުފުޅުގައި ރައީސުލްޖުމްހޫރިއްޔާ އިބްރާހީމް މުޙައްމަދު ޞާލިހުގެ އަރިހަށް އިޚްތިރާމްގެ ޒިޔާރަތެއްކުރެއްވުމާއި މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއާޒް ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދުއާ ބައްދަލު ކުރެއްވުމަށް ވަނީ ހަމަޖެހިފައެވެ. އޭގެ އިތުރުން، ހއ.އުތީމަށް ވަޑައިގަންނަވައި، އުތީމު ގަނޑުވަރަށް އިޙުތިރާމުގެ ޒިޔާރަތެއް ކުރައްވާ ގޮތަށް ވަނީ ހަމަޖެހިފައެވެ.

މިއީ އިންޑިއާގެ އެކްސްޓަރނަލް އެފެއާޒް މިނިސްޓަރުގެ ހައިޞިއްޔަތުން އެމަނިކުފާނު ރާއްޖެއަށް ކުރައްވާ ހަތަރުވަނަ ދަތުރުފުޅެވެ. އެންމެފަހުން އެމަނިކުފާނު ރާއްޖެއަށް ވަޑައިގެންފައިވަނީ 2022 ވަނަ އަހަރުގެ މާރޗް މަހު އައްޑޫ ސިޓީއަށެވެ.
